title: County funding for Lahaina Community Land Trust
summary: On April 21, a council member proposed a $6 million grant to the Lahaina Community Land Trust. The member said the grant would help homeowners who have a gap in rebuilding money. The member also said the land trust raised over $9.5 million using the County's first $6 million.
